alerts.headline: Winter Weather Advisory issued October 14 at 1:08PM MDT until October 14 at 6:00PM MDT by NWS Grand Junction CO
alerts.description:
* WHAT...Snow above 10000 feet. Additional snow accumulations of 1 to
3 inches.

* WHERE...Northwest San Juan Mountains and Southwest San Juan
Mountains.

* WHEN...Until 6 PM MDT this evening.

* IMPACTS...Travel could become slippery at times due to slushy
conditions over mountain passes.
alerts.areaDesc: Northwestern San Juan Mountains; Southwest San Juan Mountains

alerts.headline: Freeze Watch issued October 14 at 1:04PM MDT until October 16 at 10:00AM MDT by NWS Grand Junction CO
alerts.description:
* WHAT...Sub-freezing temperatures as low as 24 to 30 possible. Lower
valleys may drop to 20.

* WHERE...Central Yampa River Basin, Lower Yampa River Basin, Upper
Yampa River Basin, San Juan River Basin, and Central Colorado River
Basin.

* WHEN...From late Thursday night through Friday morning.

* IMPACTS...Frost and freeze conditions could kill crops, other
sensitive vegetation and possibly damage unprotected outdoor
plumbing.
alerts.areaDesc: Lower Yampa River Basin; Central Yampa River Basin; Upper Yampa River Basin; Central Colorado River Basin; San Juan River Basin

alerts.title: US 160 Pagosa Springs Reconstruction-147593
alerts.description: Between US 84 and Pike Drive (Pagosa Springs) from Mile Point 144.3 to Mile Point 141.8. Road construction. Starting October 16, 2026 at 7:00AM MDT until October 16, 2026 at about 6:00PM MDT. Full schedule below: • October 16, 7:00AM - October 16, 6:00PM Comment: Harman Park & Piedra Road-Work is underway at this intersection of US 160. Working hours will be intermittent day and night so motorists should plan for potential delays, Monday-Saturday. Please allow extra time to get through the work zone. Safety benefits of this work includes pedestrian safety upgrades and ADA accessibility improvements. Expect lane shifts and up to 15-minute delays. Crews will switch two-way traffic into the eastbound lanes, perform temporary striping operations and begin asphalt milling in the westbound lanes. Parking will not be permitted on US 160 and vehicles will be towed at the owner's expense. Westbound lane closures, 10’ width and 75’ length restrictions will remain in place 24/7 through end of 2026. Work is weather-dependent. For questions contact the project team at 970-335-9230 or Pagosa160reconstruction@gmail.com Project Webpage: www.codot.gov/projects/us160pagosasprings
